name: Goal-Directed Engagement (Cairn-style)
description: Scoped authorized goal-directed engagement playbook based on the Cairn Bootstrap/Reason/Explore loop. Operator declares one or more goal targets in the scope manifest `goal_targets` block; FORGE then (1) Bootstraps from passive OSINT, (2) Reasons over the current Fact set to pick the next-best scoped intent, and (3) Explores by claiming an intent and running the authorized downstream module. Progress rows and reasoning traces land in audit; the loop stops when every declared goal is reached or when the ROE budget expires. The playbook refuses to run if any declared goal falls outside the current scope manifest.
